title: 24 AI agents build my app overnight. I just review it.
hook: 24 AI agents build my app overnight. I just review it.
summary:
Can AI agents build your app overnight? Yes: 24 of them build mine while I sleep.
One command in Claude Code. Research agents scope my Linear tickets, build agents implement them, and by morning there is one draft PR and a Discord ping. I decide what ships.
Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, shows the real build.
Comment SWARM for the setup. Follow @manrajtalks
